# Two handlers whose names differ only in case produce the same exported
# TemplateRoutePaths method; the error lists where each is defined.

Error:
TemplateRoutePaths method name collision: templates "GET /items list(ctx)" and "GET /items/{id} List(ctx, id)" both produce method "List"; rename one receiver method so the exported names differ by more than the case of the first letter, leading underscores, or characters that drop out
$WORK/template.gohtml:1:11: "GET /items list(ctx)" is defined here
$WORK/template.gohtml:2:11: "GET /items/{id} List(ctx, id)" is defined here

module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type T struct{}

func (T) list(_ context.Context) string           { return "" }
func (T) List(_ context.Context, _ string) string { return "" }
